matched_packages.name: Zongzuixi114514/mooncollections/countmap
matched_packages.summary:
CountMap is a frequency counter / multiset data structure that tracks counts of items. It supports increment, decrement, set, get, total, merge, entropy calculation and finding most common items, suitable for word frequency, histogram building, and voting/consensus algorithms.

matched_packages.name: zklmbq02140831/moonbit-cbtc-atp/src/state_machine
matched_packages.summary:
Implements EN50128 SIL4 safety-critical state machines for CBTC Automatic Train Protection (ATP) systems. Includes ETCS 16-mode transitions, dual-channel 2-out-of-2 voting, and sub-state machines for operating modes like Full Supervision, On Sight, Staff Responsible, Reversing, and Shunting, used in railway signaling and train control.

Keywords: CBTC, ATP, state machine, SIL4, EN50128, ETCS, 2o2 voting, safety-critical, train protection, railway signaling, operating mode, Subset-026, Full Supervision, On Sight, 列车自动防护
